purpose: Cumulative bridge ladder for MC010-MC033, combining validated atlas rows and smoke diagnostics without promoting smoke results to atlas rows.

rungs.title: Two-hop symbolic indirection
rungs.repair_attempt: Remove direct entity-to-code rows with entity -> handle -> task-code indirection.
rungs.claim_boundary: Two-hop indirection did not create a behavior substrate.
rungs.dominant_failure: synthetic and learned controls plus conflict contrast failed

rungs.title: Same-format numeric answer interface
rungs.repair_attempt: Use integers for both prompt-local values and learned atomic facts.
rungs.claim_boundary: Answer-format repair is insufficient under prompt-local table authority.
rungs.dominant_failure: numeric conflict collapsed to prompt-local values

rungs.title: Explicit reliability labels
rungs.repair_attempt: Use visible trusted/untrusted source-status labels.
rungs.claim_boundary: Positive control only; source-status text carries the answer rule.
rungs.dominant_failure: prompt-channel locality failed

rungs.title: Text-identical status-channel ablation
rungs.repair_attempt: Reproduce MC012 with status text, then ablate the visible status channel.
rungs.claim_boundary: The contrast does not survive status-channel removal.
rungs.dominant_failure: matched ablation collapsed to prompt-local values

rungs.title: Calibration-inferred reliability
rungs.repair_attempt: Remove status labels and infer source validity from calibration rows.
rungs.claim_boundary: Calibration evidence did not overcome local table authority.
rungs.dominant_failure: calibration-consistent and inconsistent rows both local

rungs.title: Learned parity gate
rungs.repair_attempt: Make the source rule depend on hidden learned atomic-number parity.
rungs.claim_boundary: Mixed outputs are not enough when expected labels are not followed.
rungs.dominant_failure: rule-aligned expected correctness failed

rungs.title: Visible non-status alphabet gate
rungs.repair_attempt: Use a visible first-letter rule instead of source-status labels.
rungs.claim_boundary: A visible non-status gate still collapses expected-atomic rows.
rungs.dominant_failure: expected-atomic rows selected local

rungs.title: LOCAL/ATOMIC source-token answers
rungs.repair_attempt: Ask for source tokens before any numeric answer.
rungs.claim_boundary: Source-token answers are themselves a confounded behavior surface.
rungs.dominant_failure: ATOMIC selector control collapsed to LOCAL

rungs.title: Neutral counterbalanced selector labels
rungs.repair_attempt: Replace LOCAL/ATOMIC answers with counterbalanced A/B labels.
rungs.claim_boundary: Neutral labels expose first-listed-choice and local-source salience.
rungs.dominant_failure: source-rule correctness near chance with order bias

rungs.title: Neutral row-code numeric answers
rungs.repair_attempt: Keep integer answers but attach neutral route codes to rows.
rungs.claim_boundary: Clean controls and nulls do not imply expected-atomic routing.
rungs.dominant_failure: expected-atomic route weak despite clean nulls

rungs.title: Atomic recall table-pressure isolation
rungs.repair_attempt: Separate direct atomic recall under local-row pressure from route-rule arbitration.
rungs.claim_boundary: The bottleneck is conditional arbitration, not basic atomic recall.
rungs.dominant_failure: route-atomic branch collapsed toward local

rungs.title: Visible-versus-learned route-code arbitration
rungs.repair_attempt: Test the same route-code grammar on visible-visible and visible-learned branches.
rungs.claim_boundary: Opaque route codes are not a clean arbitration substrate.
rungs.dominant_failure: visible-visible route weak, learned route weaker

rungs.title: Semantic branch-name arbitration
rungs.repair_attempt: Replace opaque route codes with LOCAL/REFERENCE/ATOMIC source labels.
rungs.claim_boundary: Semantic labels do not solve learned-memory branch arbitration.
rungs.dominant_failure: local-source salience and rule-order sensitivity remain

rungs.title: Query-level operation arbitration
rungs.repair_attempt: Remove row-level source labels and use counterbalanced query operation handles.
rungs.claim_boundary: Query-level operation handles preserve controls and nulls but do not clear both conflict branches.
rungs.dominant_failure: operation-local and operation-atomic conflict branches below gate

rungs.title: Few-shot query-operation arbitration
rungs.repair_attempt: Add balanced worked examples to query operation handles.
rungs.claim_boundary: Worked examples repair local routing but not full-source learned atomic routing.
rungs.dominant_failure: operation-atomic branch below gate with other-number leakage

rungs.title: Constrained choice operation arbitration
rungs.repair_attempt: Constrain final answers to A/B/C options containing local number, atomic number, and UNKNOWN.
rungs.claim_boundary: Prompt-visible candidate choices break atomic controls and nulls while leaving learned conflict routing weak.
rungs.dominant_failure: direct atomic control and answer-absent null failed under choice interface

rungs.title: Prompt-visible numeric-option arbitration
rungs.repair_attempt: Show local number, atomic number, and UNKNOWN as allowed answers, but require returning the actual number or UNKNOWN.
rungs.claim_boundary: Numeric options preserve nulls but turn direct atomic control into UNKNOWN and leave learned conflict routing weak.
rungs.dominant_failure: direct atomic control abstains and operation-atomic branch remains below gate

rungs.title: Answer-interface sweep
rungs.repair_attempt: Sweep bare integer, prefix, JSON, A/B/C, and numeric-option answer interfaces on one operation substrate.
rungs.claim_boundary: Bare integer clears the 10-source smoke, but structured interfaces distort controls, nulls, or learned routing; MC024 remains the full-source boundary.
rungs.dominant_failure: answer interfaces change behavior strongly and only the inherited bare-integer route survives smoke

rungs.title: Bare-integer full-source boundary
rungs.repair_attempt: Run MC027's winning bare-integer answer interface on the full 40-source set.
rungs.claim_boundary: The bare-integer smoke survivor fails full-source promotion: controls and nulls stay clean, but operation-atomic rows fall below gate with other-number leakage.
rungs.dominant_failure: full-source learned atomic branch below gate with other-number leakage

rungs.title: Operation leak factorial
rungs.repair_attempt: Factor MC028's other-number leak across numeric examples, label-only examples, rules-only, query-before-example ordering, and query-row-last table ordering.
rungs.claim_boundary: No variant passes the bridge gate. Rules-only improves operation-atomic routing to 0.875 and removes worked-example outputs, but answer-absent nulls fall to 0.806; query-before-examples amplifies other-number leakage.
rungs.dominant_failure: branch/null tradeoff after worked-example removal

rungs.title: Null-preserving rules repair
rungs.repair_attempt: Add explicit absence guards to MC029's rules-only prompt while preserving full-source panels.
rungs.claim_boundary: No guard variant passes. The unguarded rules-only baseline remains the best branch/null compromise; guards either worsen nulls or collapse learned atomic routing.
rungs.dominant_failure: branch/null tradeoff persists under absence guards

rungs.title: Statusless reliability bridge
rungs.repair_attempt: Replace visible status labels and operation examples with arithmetic checksum validity as a source-reliability cue.
rungs.claim_boundary: Direct controls, valid-checksum local rows, and answer-absent nulls are clean in smoke, but invalid-checksum rows select local numbers on every selected conflict.
rungs.dominant_failure: statusless invalid-source branch collapses to local despite available atomic recall

rungs.title: Post-checksum cross-table consistency
rungs.repair_attempt: Replace arithmetic checksum validity with agreement between two neutral local tables.
rungs.claim_boundary: Direct controls, answer-absent nulls, and side-number locality are clean in smoke, but mismatch rows still avoid the learned atomic branch.
rungs.dominant_failure: statusless cross-table mismatch collapses toward the primary local number

rungs.title: Row-local fact-claim comparison
rungs.repair_attempt: Replace checksum and cross-table cues with a row-local standard-number claim checked against learned atomic memory.
rungs.claim_boundary: Direct controls and answer-absent nulls are clean in smoke, but the match branch returns atomic answers too often and mismatch rows split between local and the wrong claimed number.
rungs.dominant_failure: fact-claim validity does not produce stable local-versus-learned routing

allowed_claim: Across MC010-MC033, the only clean local-versus-learned bridge contrast is MC012's prompt-visible status-label positive control; every attempted non-status or ablated repair remains blocked before hidden-state work. MC024 shows that balanced worked examples can repair the prompt-local branch while the learned atomic branch remains the limiting failure. MC025 shows that prompt-visible choice constraints add control and null failures rather than repairing that branch. MC026 shows that numeric option lists preserve nulls but turn direct atomic recall into UNKNOWN. MC027 shows that answer-interface format is itself a strong behavior surface: bare integer answers survive 10-source smoke, while prefix, JSON, choice, and numeric-option interfaces fail different gates. MC028 closes that survivor at full-source scale: controls and nulls stay clean, but the learned atomic branch falls below gate with other-number leakage. MC029 shows that removing numeric examples can improve the learned branch, but the resulting rules-only variant breaks answer-absent nulls; factor movement is not bridge repair. MC030 shows that explicit absence guards do not repair that tradeoff and can make answer-absent rows substantially worse. MC031 tests a materially different statusless checksum cue: direct controls and nulls stay clean, but invalid-checksum conflict rows still collapse to local answers. MC032 then replaces checksum validity with cross-table consistency and finds the same broader boundary: mismatch rows still avoid the learned atomic branch while side-number leakage stays absent. MC033 then tests row-local fact claims against learned atomic memory and closes the post-MC032 repair route: direct controls and nulls stay clean, but the match and mismatch branches do not implement stable routing.
forbidden_claim: This ladder does not establish a hidden signature, causal intervention, or deployable knowledge-control mechanism.
